questions.question: In the given histogram, in which class interval, the median lies?
questions.solution:
If number of the observation is n is odd, then the median is [(n + 1)/2]th observation.

If number of the observation is n is even, then the median will be the average of the (n/2)th and [(n/2 + 1)]th observation.

Total number of students = 50 + 70 + 85 + 90 + 60 + 45 = 400

Median = [(400/2) + (400/2) + 1)]2 = (200 + 201)/2 = 200.5th (201th) students (which comes in 60 - 70)

Number of students who lies (40 - 50) = 50 students

Number of students who lies (50 - 60) = 70 students = 51th to 120th

Number of students who lies (60 - 70) = 85 students = 121th to 205th

So, 200.5th (201th) students comes in 60 - 70.

questions.question: The radius of a cylinder is increased by 60% and height of cylinder decreased by 20%. What is percentage increase in its’s volume?
questions.solution:
Let the radius and height of cylinder be r and h cm respectively.

Volume of cylinder = π r²h

If radius increased by 60%

New radius of cylinder = r × [160/100] = 1.6r

If height decreased by 20%, then

New height of the cylinder = h × (80/100) = 0.8h

New volume of the cylinder = π × (1.6r)² × 0.8h = 2.048 × π r²h

Volume increased by = 2.048 × πr²h - πr²h = 1.048 πr²h

Volume increased in percentage by = [(1.048 πr²h)/πr²h] × 100 = 104.8%

**Short Trick**

60% + 60% + [(60% × 60%)/100] = 120% + 36% = 156%

156% - 20% - [(156% × 20%)/100] = 136% - 31.20% = 104.8%

The price of sugar has increased by 14%. By what percentage can a person decrease the consumption so that there is an increase in the expenditure by 8% only? (correct to on decimal place)
questions.solution:
Let the price of the sugar be 100x

Expenditure should be increased 8% only, then new affordable price = 100x × (108/100) = 108x

Price of sugar after increment = 100x × (114/100) = 114x

Ratio of sugar of affordable price and after increment = 108x ∶ 114x

As we know, consumption of sugar is inversely proportional to price

So, consumption ratio of sugar before and after = 114x ∶ 108x

So, consumption of sugar in the starting = 114x

Consumption of sugar should be after increment = 108x

Consumption decrease by = 114x - 108x = 6x

Required percentage = (6x/114) × 100 = 5.26% = 5.3% (approx)

⇒ 3x63496 should be divisible by 11, then the divisibility rule by 11

⇒ 3 - x + 6 - 3 + 4 - 9 + 6 = 0

⇒ x = 7

⇒ (2x + 3y)

⇒ (2 × 7 + 3 × 6)

⇒ 14 + 18

⇒ 322f

questions.solution:

51² = 24² + 45²

2601 = 576 + 2025

Now we can say triangle is right angled triangle

Area of right angled triangle = (1/2) × Base × height = (1/2) × 24 × 45 = 540 cm²

Area Covered in triangle by 3 circles = (θ₁ /360) πR² + (θ₂ /360) πR² + (θ₃ /360) πR² = [(θ1 + θ2 + θ3)/360] × πR²

As we know,

θ₁ + θ₂ + θ₃ = 180°

questions.question: A boat can go 10 km downstream and 8 km upstream in 49 minutes. Also, it can go 12 km downstream and 4 km upstream in 42 minutes. What is the speed of stream in km/h?
questions.solution:
As we know, 49 min = 49/60 hr and 42 min = 42/60 hr

Let the speed of boat be x km/hr and the speed of stream be y km/hr.

∴ Speed of boat in downstream = (x + y) km/hr

∴ Speed of boat in upstream = (x - y) km/hr

According to the question

⇒ 10/(x + y) + 8/(x - y) = 49/60

Let 1/(x + y) = a, and 1/(x - y) = b, then

⇒ 10a + 8b = 49/60 ----(1)

⇒ 12/(x + y) + 4/(x - y) = 42/60

⇒ 12a + 4b = 42/60 ----(2)

Multiply by 2 in equation (2)

⇒ 24a + 8b = 84/60 ----(3)

Subtract equation (3) from (1)

⇒ 14a = 84/60 - 49/60 = 35/60

⇒ a = 1/24

Put the value of equation (2)

⇒ 12/24 + 4b = 42/60

⇒ 4b = 42/60 - 1/2 = 12/60 = 1/5

⇒ b = 1/20

If, a = 1/24, then

⇒ a/(x + y) = 1/24

⇒ (x + y) = 24 ----(4)

⇒ If b = 1/20, then

⇒ 1/(x - y) = 1/20

⇒ (x - y) = 20 ----(5)

From equation (4) and equation (5)

⇒ x = 22 & y = 2

Speed of stream is 2 km/hr

questions.question: What is the sum of digits of the least number, which when divided by 15, 18 and 42 leaves the same remainder 8 in each case and is also divisible by 13?

But the condition is, the number should also be completely divisible by 13

When we put x = 3, then number become (6 × 3 + 8) = 26 which is divisible by 13, so x = 3

630x + 8

1890 + 8

1898

questions.question: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 16 hours and 20 hours respectively. They are opened alternatively for 1 hour each. Starting with pipe A first. In how many hours with the empty tank be filled?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total work (LCM of 16, 20) = 80 units.

Efficiency: A = 5, B = 4. 2-hour cycle (A+B) = 9 units.

8 cycles (16 hours) = 9 × 8 = 72 units. Remaining = 80 − 72 = 8 units.

17th hour (Pipe A) fills 5 units. Remaining = 3 units.

Time for B to finish = 3 ÷ 4 = 3/4 hours. Total time = 17 + 3/4 = 17(3/4) hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 17(3/4) hours.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 Pipe A 16 hours 80 units 5 
 Pipe B 20 hours 4 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total capacity of tank = LCM(16, 20) = 80 units.

⇒ Work done in 1st hour (A) = 5 units.

⇒ Work done in 2nd hour (B) = 4 units.

⇒ Work done in 1 cycle (2 hours) = 5 + 4 = 9 units.

⇒ In 8 cycles (16 hours), work done = 9 × 8 = 72 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 80 − 72 = 8 units.

⇒ On 17th hour, Pipe A works and fills 5 units.

⇒ Remaining work after 17 hours = 8 − 5 = 3 units.

⇒ Now it is Pipe B's turn. Time taken by B = 3/4 hours.

⇒ Total time = 17 + 3/4 = 17(3/4) hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 17(3/4) hours.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alternate Work Principle

When pipes work alternatively, calculate the work done in one complete cycle (sum of individual efficiencies) and multiply to reach near the total work.

Pipes & Cisterns Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken. Total Work = Efficiency × Time. For inlet pipes, efficiency is positive; for outlet pipes, it is negative.</p

questions.question: A, B and C started a business by investing Rs. 1,37,500, Rs. 1,62,500 and Rs. 1,87,500 respectively. A is a working partner and gets 20% of the profit as working allowance and remaining is distributed in the proportion of their investment. If the total profit is Rs. 2,19,375 what is the share of C?
questions.solution:
A get 20% of the total profit as working allowance and remaining 80% is distributed of their investment, then

Ratio of money invested by A, B and C = 1,37,500 ∶ 1,62,500 ∶ 1,87,500 = 11 ∶ 13 ∶ 15

Total profit is = 2,19,375

Distributed profit = 2,19,375 × (80/100) = 1,75,500

Share of C = 1,75,500 × (15/39) = 67,500

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 10,000 is invested for 17 months at 8% per annum compounded half yearly. What is the percentage gain at the end of 17 month, nearest to one decimal place?
questions.solution:
Rate = 8% per annum

⇒ Rate for 6 months = 8%/2 = 4%

⇒ Rate for 5 months = (8/12) × 5 = (10/3) %

Short Trick

Percentage gain at the end of 12 month = 4% + 4% + (4% × 4%)/100 = 8% + 0.16% = 8.16%

Percentage gain at the end of 17 month = 8.16% + (10/3)% + [8.16% × (10/3)%]/100 = 8.16% + 3.33% + 0.272% = 11.762% = 11.8% (approx)
